images.alt: An image with a light blue background and a windy symbol, with the metservice logo in the bottom right corner. The image is covered by text which reads peak observed wind gusts, friday 27th of June. Brothers Island 159kph, Mt Kaukau 154kph, New Plymouth airport 128kph, Kelburn 124kph, Wellington airport 122kph.

post.text:
🍃 After a very wet and windy 24 hours, high pressure is taking charge. 🌞

🌬️ It's still blustery for wellington, with gusts of around 70-80 km/h, but that wind will continue to ease.

🥶 A very cold morning for the south, with temperatures of -7°C for Tekapo, Mt Cook and Alexandra.

source.agency_name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand (MetService NZ)
